name: My Himbo Sensei: Chapter One
source:
You're a beginner Japanese student at Bara University and your teacher is a sexy, muscular man. It turns out you're the only one in the class and he's really motivated to make sure you pass. He'll do anything to get you to study! Anything.

[From [url=https://deevil.itch.io/my-himbo-sensei-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
